mapper.select: select #{userId} as user_id, sum(r.total_calories) as total_calories, sum(r.total_protein) as total_protein, sum(r.total_fat) as total_fat, sum(r.total_carbohydrate) as total_carbohydrate from diet_record r where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.record_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}
select count(1) from diet_record where date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(now(),'%Y-%m-%d')

select date_format(record_date,'%Y-%m-%d') as `date`, count(1) as `count` from diet_record where record_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 9 day) group by date_format(record_date,'%Y-%m-%d') order by `date` asc

SELECT TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.notes, '、', numbers.n), '、', -1)) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM diet_record r JOIN ( SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 ) numbers ON CHAR_LENGTH(r.notes) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(r.notes, '、', '')) >= numbers.n - 1 WHERE r.notes IS NOT NULL AND r.notes != '' GROUP BY name HAVING name != '' ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 5
